notes.title: Update on changes
notes.content:
Hi all we know people are having issues in finding our information and we know it’s not a great way of working everything out but as it stands we are having trying to sort all the steam side out so please bare with us.
As for now if you have a copy of Station 21 which you purchased and haven’t got access to a code yet then please send proof of purchase to: rteccgames@gmail.com​

​Thank you.
P.S Please remember Station 22 will be coming to steam once in playable alpha so this code is to secure your name on our database that we will use to send out steam keys once they are available.
(This includes non public releases)

notes.title: Update v1.2
notes.content:
Here is a few new things that have been changed in Station 21, we are sorry for the delay in updates it's been a busy few months.

Update v1.2 Changes:
- Increased power bank range
- Added speed controls
- Added new original score
- Changed starting cash
- Added difficulty options
- Added auto update reboot
- Fixed issue with Part delivery


Now the new difficulty options mean asteroids spawn either more or less, and the starting cash amount is more or less.

IMPORTANT NOTE:
As of this release updates that will destroy saves will automatically delete previous save games.

So please backup before updating.

notes.title: Release Update V1.0
notes.content:
Hi all its been a rocky year to say the least but thanks for all the support everyone has given us in making this game better. 
We have learned a lot from releasing Station 21 and next time hope to make everything go a lot smoother.

This by no means that Station 21 won't receive updates, we are still looking to update every month for the next year, it just means we can focus on other things in the background but this very much still remains our main priority.

Thanks to everyone, we hope you enjoy and we will see you on the other side.

notes.title: Aeon Arise update
notes.content:
Hello everyone, just to let you all know what the latest is on Aeon Arise.
We know we said to release November but with work commitments its been hard to had the team focus on development.

We are now pushing hard for a Christmas release, we have updated all our menu, GUI and are currently placing all the galaxy's systems and stations.

When we release AA you will be able to build a ship from your station and fly out into the galaxy, your ship will have an inventory in which you can buy items from other stations to save money launching missions to resupply.

You will also be able to earn money from scanning systems for data or releasing scanning limpets to stay and earn.

Currently we have 21 systems/stations in the galaxy but as we speak we are expanding and hoping to have double that on release.

Thank you all for your patience we hope to see you flying around soon.

R-Tecc Games Team.
